challenges.title: The Reset
challenges.description: The all-rounder. Week 1 move, week 2 fuel, week 3 recover, week 4 lock it in. Best place to start.

challenges.title: Stair Season
challenges.description: Take the stairs every time you have the option for 28 days. Free cardio hiding in every building on campus.

challenges.title: Deep Sleep 28
challenges.description: Same sleep and wake window, 7 days a week. The most underrated thing you can do for your blood pressure.

challenges.title: Caffeine Curfew
challenges.description: No caffeine after 2pm for four weeks. Watch your resting heart rate and sleep quality change.

challenges.title: 8K Study Breaks
challenges.description: Hit 8,000 steps a day by breaking study sessions with a lap outside. Focus goes up too.

challenges.title: Nicotine-Free 28
challenges.description: Four weeks off vapes and cigarettes, with daily check-ins and what to expect week by week.
